#@ requires 1 == 1
#@ ensures 1 == 1
#@ assigns \nothing
def uses_continue(stmts: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
    found = 0
    n = len(stmts)
    i = 0
    #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
    #@ loop invariant found == 0 or found == 1
    #@ loop variant n - i
    while i < n and found == 0:
        stmt = stmts[i]
        if stmt["stmt"] == "Continue":
            found = 1
        else:
            j = 0
            #@ loop invariant 0 <= j and j <= 2
            #@ loop invariant found == 0 or found == 1
            #@ loop variant 2 - j
            while j < 2 and found == 0:
                if j == 0:
                    key = "body"
                else:
                    key = "orelse"
                if key in stmt and IRScanner.uses_continue(stmt[key]):
                    found = 1
                j += 1
        i += 1
    return found == 1
